construction_notes.text: Office conversion, nine-story building. Article does not state rental or for-sale; product type is a working label.
Removed a "Flow" party tag: SJ Build shows the word "Flow" in its status line without naming a developer, and no other source ties Flow to this site.

SF YIMBY reports the owner is a group linked to the founder of Flow, a residential real estate company, and a Flow executive. The tower dates from 1985 and keeps the 1909 facade of Eagles Hall; the site spans North 3rd to North 4th Street between Saint John and Saint James Streets.

City planning layer: PRE24-387 applicant is C2K Architecture, Inc; description "To Request Preliminary Feedback on changing primary occupancy from type B- Office to Type R-2." Intake date 2025-01-07, status Complete.
